text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PIN applied: runtime v4.7 pinned for model-group 'summary-llama' in eu-central-1. Trigger: increased 5xx and model-bind failures after SDK 3.4.1 canary. Pin window: 6h. Link: https://ops/inc/1791239999. CC @mike @ayana

mike: observed spike around 07:22 CET. model-bind errors: `ERR_BIND_MISMATCH` when serving prompt variants with function-calling metadata. suspect SDK change that altered signature encoding.

ayana: i saw a similar stacktrace in staging earlier but assumed it was test noise. can we route only function-calling traffic to runtime v4.5 and keep normal generation on v4.7? header-based routing possible?

chris: yes, deploy-bot supports header and query routing. short-term plan: add header rule `x-features: funccall=true` -> runtime v4.5 in eu-central-1, keep pin in place. also pause SDK canary. long-term: rollback or patch SDK to restore signature encoding spec.

sre-bot: ops commands (requires ops role):

```
/deploy pin runtime v4.7 --model summary-llama --region eu-central-1 --reason "bind failures after sdk 3.4.1"
/deploy route add --from runtime:v4.7 --to runtime:v4.5 --region eu-central-1 --match "header:x-features=funccall"
/deploy canary pause sdk 3.4.1
```

mike: routing rule applied. quick verification: funccall traffic p50/p95 back to baseline, bind error count dropped to 0 in last 10m. thanks.

ayana: i'll open a revert PR for the SDK change that touched signature encoding and include compatibility tests. PR: https://git/repo/pull/6789. will add unit test to validate external encoding + runtime acceptance matrix.

chris: plan for soft-unpin: wait for PR merge + canary verification. proposed window: 01:00 UTC (low traffic) next day. ramp: 2% -> 20% -> 80% -> 100% with 10m gates. rollback triggers: bind-errors >0 OR 5xx > 5 in 5m OR p95 > baseline+25%.

sre-bot: monitoring rule suggestion committed: page #eng-oncall and revert to runtime v4.5 automatically if bind-errors > 0 for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

mike: drafting release note: "Temporary pin of runtime v4.7 in eu-central-1 for summary-llama due to model-bind failures with SDK 3.4.1; function-calling traffic routed to v4.5 while SDK patch is implemented. Customers: some function-call enabled integrations in EU may have seen errors; mitigation applied." will post to #release-notes after review.

ayana: follow-ups: (1) merge SDK revert PR and run compatibility matrix, (2) add regression test in CI to catch bind-encoding mismatches, (3) confirm gate numbers during ramp. i'll own the PR and tests.

chris: once we pass canary metrics for 30m at 20% ramp, schedule the next ramp. keep this thread updated with timestamps and metric snapshots.

sre-bot: note: pin remains active. to request manual unpin before schedule use `/deploy unpin runtime v4.7 --region eu-central-1` and tag eng-releases.

mike: thanks team—closing when soft-unpin completes and postmortem published. :lock:
